SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY,
CHANCERY DIVISION, CUMBERLAND COUNTY,
DOCKET NO. F422725,
PINE VALLEY ONE REAL ESTATE LLC vs. WHITEMARSH ESTATES INC ET AL.
Execution of sale of Premises (Incident to Foreclosure of Tax Sale Certificate).
By virtue of a Writ of Execution, directed to me (the “Sheriff of Cumberland County” or “Sheriff”), out of the Superior Court of New Jersey, in the above entitled matter, I shall expose for sale to the highest bidder by Public Auction to be held at the Cumberland County Sheriff’s Office located at 220 N. Laurel Street, City of Bridgeton, County of Cumberland, State of New Jersey 08302, on:
Wednesday, 10/7/2026 next, at 2:00 P.M. [prevailing time]
all of that certain tract of land, situate, lying and being in the CITY OF MILLVILLE, County of Cumberland and State of New Jersey:
PROPERTY COMMONLY KNOWN AS: 332 RIECK AVENUE MILLVILLE, NJ
TAX LOT: 60 AND BLOCK: 52
DIMENSIONS OF LOT: 50 X 315
NUMBER OF FEET TO NEAREST CROSS STREET: 662 FEET TO MEGAN DRIVE
THIS CONCISE STATEMENT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A FULL LEGAL DESCRIPTION.
THE FULL LEGAL DESCRIPTION CAN BE FOUND IN THE OFFICE OF THE CLERK OF CUMBERLAND COUNTY IN BOOK 1638 AT PAGE 207
OCCUPANCY STATUS AT THIS PROPERTYIS UNKNOWN
AMOUNT OF TAXES DUE AND PRIOR LIENS: $933.34
THIS SHERIFF’S SALE SHALL BE MADE SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING:
• Any and all unpaid taxes, assessments, water and sewer charges and/or liens (if any). Any and all interested parties must check with the tax collector, municipality, and/or utilities authority for the exact amount(s) due;
• Any and all mortgage(s), judgment(s), lien(s) and/or encumbrance(s) that remain outstanding (if any);
• Any and all condominium association and/or homeowner association liens that remain outstanding (if any);
• Any and all zoning ordinances, easements, restrictions, reversions, reservations, rights of way, and/or covenants of record (if any);
• The rights of tenants and/or occupants of the property (if any);
• Federal, state, and/or local laws, rules, regulations, and/or ordinances.
• The rights (including, but not limited to, the right of redemption) of the United States of America (if any); and
• Such state of facts as an accurate survey, title search, and/or physical inspection of the property may reveal.
• The Property is being sold in “AS IS” condition with any and all faults of any and every kind and nature.
Any and all interested parties shall conduct and rely solely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether any outstanding interest(s) remain of record and/or have priority over the tax lien being foreclosed; and, if so, the current amount due thereon. Interested parties are further directed to review the Notice of Sale (see New Jersey Court Rule 4:65-2 and N.J.S.A. 46:26A-11) on file in the Sheriff’s Office prior to bidding.
THE APPROXIMATE AMOUNT OF THE JUDGMENT TO BE SATISFIED BY SAID THIS SALE IS $8,349.05 , WITH INTEREST COSTS OF THIS SALE.
PLAINTIFF HAS ADVISED THE SHERIFF THAT A GOOD FAITH ESTIMATE OF THE “UPSET PRICE” ON THE DAY OF THE SHERIFF’S SALE SHALL BE $14,000.00 .
The successful (i.e. high) bidder shall tender a deposit in the amount of twenty percent (20%) of the bid price in cash and/or by certified or cashier's check, payable to the “Sheriff of Cumberland County”, immediately upon the conclusion of the foreclosure sale. The balance of the purchase price shall be due in thirty (30) calendar days. The Cumberland County Sheriff’s Office will not accept cash payments in excess of One Thousand Dollars ($1,000.00) without prior written approval so that special arrangements can be made. Bidders are advised to bring certified and/or cashier’s checks for any and all payments in excess of this amount.
NEW JERSEY FORECLOSURE INTERVENTION FUND: Pursuant to N.J.S.A. 2A:17-38, the Sheriff will charge and collect $350.00 from each sale. These funds are utilized in accordance with the New Jersey Foreclosure Prevention Act (codified at N.J.S.A. 55:14K-94 et seq.); and will be included in the Upset Price announced at the time of the Sheriff’s Sale.
SURPLUS MONEY: If after the sale and satisfaction of the tax debt, including interest, costs, and/or expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a Motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
ADJOURNMENTS: The Sheriff reserves the right to adjourn the sale from time to time as provided by law without further notice or publication.
Persons that need an accommodation (e.g. sign language, interpreter, assisted listening devices, etc.) must notify the County Office for the Disabled, 800 East Commerce Street, Bridgeton, New Jersey 08302, (856)453-2156 within fourteen (14) days of the scheduled meeting. Cumberland County cannot provide any accommodation not requested.
ALL PUBLICATION COSTS SHALL BE PAID FOR BY THE PLAINTIFF.
MICHAEL DONATO
SHERIFF
HONIG & GREENBERG, L.L.C. Atty (s)
Phone: 856-770-0990
Advertisement dates
